actions.cleanup: release to the preregistered successor and land
actions.marker: a fault_detected event whose reason names a stalled stream
actions.precondition: an external route holds complete authority and no fault has been observed yet in this episode
actions.summary: Stop the owned setpoint stream while proof-of-life continues.

actions.cleanup: a complete internal safe route must install without operator action
actions.marker: a fault_detected event whose reason names a producer exit
actions.precondition: an external route holds complete authority and no fault has been observed yet in this episode
actions.summary: Terminate the producer that owns the installed external route.

actions.cleanup: exactly one successor must win and install completely
actions.notes: the request is a public Land command, so porting it from the mode executor was an anchoring change rather than a new stimulus
actions.precondition: some route currently holds complete authority
actions.summary: Issue a public Land request next to the completion boundary.

actions.cleanup: the final entry must release to a landing successor
actions.marker: a transition_requested event the producer recorded as a repeat cycle
actions.notes: the intermediate safe route is a parameter: the core corpus selects Hold, while the retained evidence that validates this predicate uses the RTL variant. The derived re_entry phase is deliberately broader than this action, because a fixture can enter a route twice without any tester action; the marker therefore uses the producer's own recorded cycle rather than the system's observed behaviour. The dynamic requester has no re-entry loop yet
actions.precondition: a completion has been observed and an internal safe route now holds complete authority
actions.summary: Request the tested route again while an internal safe route holds authority.

actions.cleanup: the vehicle must reach an internal safe route and disarm
actions.marker: a fault_detected event whose reason names a rejection
actions.notes: legacy offboard has no health-reply protocol, so this is not portable. It is a launch configuration rather than a runtime action: the withhold must already be in effect when the activation is requested, so there is no moment to choose and no request to record. The policy still selects whether an episode tests the rejection path
actions.precondition: activation of the external route has been requested and no external route holds authority yet
actions.summary: Withhold the external mode health reply so activation is refused.

actions.cleanup: stop every additional component and keep the primary session consistent
actions.marker: a registration event whose result code reports a rejection
actions.notes: legacy offboard has no registration protocol, so this is not portable. Starting all eight components on the policy's request was flown twice and failed both times the same way: the boundary was reached, with two refused, but registering them spanned the whole active period and the moving profile never reached its completion progress. The seven legal slots are now filled during setup and the policy times only the eighth, which is the one that must be refused and the one the action is actually about
actions.precondition: the episode is running and some route holds complete authority
actions.summary: Register components until a further registration is refused.

actions.cleanup: either the reclaim installs completely or the safe route is retained
actions.marker: a transition_requested returning to an external route after a producer loss
actions.notes: the only proposed action whose legality depends on the outcome of an earlier action, which is what separates feedback-guided generation from feedback-free generation. A first attempt found it unreachable because the runner learned of the producer loss by polling the process, about eleven seconds after telemetry already showed the installed safe route, by which time the aircraft had landed. The loss is now observed from telemetry, which leaves the measured ten second window; the tested failsafe configuration is unchanged
actions.precondition: a producer loss has been observed and an internal safe route now holds complete authority
actions.summary: Restart the producer after a loss and reclaim authority.
